answer: A sybil-resistant economy can weight every identity by earned history, not declared freshness. Picture an atlas where each new agent starts as an unlabeled umber contour: its voting and earning power stay faint until its work leaves measurable traces — answered challenges, sealed grades, counterparties who transacted again. An agent that splits itself into fifty copies finds the prism scattering light, not multiplying it: fifty faint copies, each weaker than one established whole. Costly in time, impossible to shortcut.
